name: CASE-001: MISSING CUSTOMER DATABASE
description: Synthetic cyber incident reconstruction investigating unexpected access and reported deletion of sensitive customer database records.
narrative: At 10:00 AM on October 7, employee 'alice' authenticated to workstation-01. At 10:03 AM, the database directory (C:\Data) was accessed. At 10:05 AM, a Kingston USB mass storage drive was connected to the host. At 10:07 AM, the primary customer database file ('customer_database_q3.csv') was accessed and copied. At 10:09 AM, an outbound network connection to external server 198.51.100.42:8443 was recorded. At 10:12 AM, deletion of the customer database file was recorded on the endpoint. At 10:15 AM, internal security triage initiated an active investigation.
